name: Collective Obligation

frame.name: Void Leech
frame.description: This weapon stores Void debuffs when damaging foes, leeching them directly when the target is suppressed, weakened, or volatile. Once charged, [Alternate Weapon Action]  to cause damage from this weapon and to apply the stored debuffs.

perks.name: Arrowhead Brake
perks.description:
Lightly vented barrel.
  •  Greatly controls recoil
  •  Increases handling speed

perks.name: Flared Magwell
perks.description:
Optimized for fast reloading.
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Greatly increases reload speed

perks.name: Umbral Sustenance
perks.description: This weapon's magazine is automatically reloaded when you gain Devour, a Void overshield, or become invisible.

perks.name: Hand-Laid Stock
perks.description:
This weapon is optimized for recoil control.
  •  Increases stability

flavor: "What The Witness gave me, I give to you. May it serve you in death, or in finality. It cannot be both." —Rhulk, disciple of the Witness

catalyst.name: Collective Obligation Catalyst
catalyst.description: Defeating a Void-debuffed target grants an overshield.
